professional.label: Professional
professional.tone_description: polished, respectful and confident, like a well-run brand writing to a valued client. Clear and to the point, no slang.

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.tone_description: warm, casual and conversational, like a friend giving a genuine recommendation. Contractions are fine, keep it light.

luxury.label: Luxury
luxury.tone_description: elegant, refined and a little exclusive, the way a premium boutique speaks to loyal customers. Understated, never shouty.

festive.label: Festive
festive.tone_description: upbeat and celebratory, fits a holiday or seasonal sale. Energetic without being over the top.
